title: Gym timings says 'Right now members see' for times that are not saved yet
what: While the owner is still changing the gym timings, the top line reads 'Right now members see: Open now…' from what is typed on the screen. Members still see the last saved timings, or nothing at all the first time, until the owner taps Save.
expected: Before saving, the line says it is a preview of what members will see after Save. Only saved timings are called what members see right now.
how_often: every time the owner edits the timings before saving, and always on first set-up
fix_line: Word the line as a preview until the timings on screen are the saved ones
